title: Mobility in the City
summary: Routes, city transport, local movement, and navigation.
whyItMatters: Urban mobility language helps you compare transport, understand disruptions, and choose practical routes through a city.

mentalModel.title: Route equals stages
mentalModel.content: Break a trip into start, transport, transfer, walking segment, and destination.

mentalModel.title: Compare time, cost, and reliability
mentalModel.content: A useful transport choice depends on more than speed.

ruleBlocks.title: Name transport actions precisely
ruleBlocks.content: Use einsteigen, aussteigen, umsteigen, abfahren, ankommen, and zu Fuß gehen.

ruleBlocks.title: Read service information
ruleBlocks.content: Identify line, direction, platform, departure, delay, cancellation, and replacement service.

ruleBlocks.title: Compare realistic options
ruleBlocks.content: Use schneller, günstiger, direkter, bequemer, and zuverlässiger with a reason.

tables.title: City Route Map
rows: Wie weit ist es zu Fuß?

examples.de: Ich fahre mit der U-Bahn bis zum Hauptbahnhof.
examples.en: I take the subway to the main station.

examples.de: Am Rathaus musst du in die Linie 4 umsteigen.
examples.en: At city hall you have to change to line 4.

examples.de: Das Fahrrad ist auf dieser Strecke schneller als der Bus.
examples.en: The bicycle is faster than the bus on this route.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ignore the direction shown for a line.
commonMistakes.correct: Name the line and its destination direction.
commonMistakes.reason: The same line runs both ways.

comparisons.summary: Two-way prepositions distinguish destination from location.
The communication lesson turns route stages into clear instructions.
